# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "D096 heap_exhausted"
description: "On the WASM runtime, the heap limit (SAKURA_MAX_HEAP) was reached or memory could not grow."
---

A runtime defect: the running program stops with it; no compile phase reports it, and `try` cannot catch it. `sakura explain D096` prints this explanation offline.

On the WASM runtime, the heap limit (`SAKURA_MAX_HEAP`) was reached or memory could not grow.
The task ends without running further user code. Raise the limit or reduce live data
(`runtime/rt/ABI.md` §13).

Runtime defects come from running programs, so `compiler/tests/ui` has no fixture for them; the explanation above names the repair.
